---
title: Content
---

This section contains the core files, reading and slides for each week. We will work through the relevant chapter(s) from the textbook, with support from file downloads and some class slides.

The main textbook for this course is [**R for Non-Programmers**](https://r4np.com){target="_blank"} by Daniel Dauber — a free, openly available online book written specifically for social science students with no prior programming experience.

::: {.callout-tip}
### How to use this section

1. **Read** the assigned r4np chapter(s)
2. **Review** the slides if available
3. **Download** any related R code files
4. **Take notes** or make comments for future reference
3. **Then** work through the interactive lessons, videos and assignments for the week
:::
